html: The Nungali, also called Ilngali, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the Victoria River district of the Northern Territory. The map shows them from 1600 to 1815. Little is recorded about them. Their neighbours were the Ngaliwurru and Jaminjung to the north and west, the Ngarinyman and Bilinarra to the south and the Wagiman to the northeast. Large cattle stations took over the Victoria River country from the 1880s.
